notes.text: In the Americas, where dog-mediated rabies is mostly controlled, hematophagous (blood-feeding) bats are now the primary source of human rabies.
Any direct contact with a bat is treated as a category III exposure.
notes.source: WHO — Expert Consultation on Rabies, TRS 1012 (2018)

notes.text: Bat rabies: Bat rabies has not been conclusively proved in India and hence, at present, exposure to bats does not warrant PEP.
notes.source: NCDC India — National Guidelines on Rabies Prophylaxis (2015)
